schema_notes.schema_origin: Uses the prior custom schema, extended to version 1.2.0 with a MINIMUM group operator and selection_constraints for elective unit and item thresholds.
schema_notes.local_ids: Institution, course, requirement, and group IDs are local identifiers, not official institution or ASSIST identifiers. Requirement and group IDs are scoped to dataset_id; keep articulation rules scoped to this agreement when combining datasets.
schema_notes.source_pages: Page numbers are one-based positions in the supplied PDF.
schema_notes.course_units: Units belong to the institution listing the course. Source and target units are retained separately; articulation does not make their unit values equal.
schema_notes.course_operator: COURSE refers to one canonical course record.
schema_notes.or_operator: OR requires at least one complete operand, referenced requirement, or child group. Never flatten an OR of AND bundles into independent per-course alternatives.
schema_notes.and_operator: AND requires every operand, referenced requirement, and child group. It encodes fulfillment, not prerequisite order.
schema_notes.cross_listed_codes: No cross-listed course codes are stated in this agreement.
schema_notes.no_course_articulated: A null source_requirement with this status means the agreement lists no Chabot equivalent. The target requirement still exists; null does not mean the requirement is waived, already satisfied, or globally impossible to fulfill.
schema_notes.dag_direction: Connect source course expressions through articulation rules to receiving-course expressions and then requirement groups. Whole-sequence and individual mappings may fulfill the same target courses. The resulting edges describe fulfillment, not prerequisites.
schema_notes.prerequisites: Null prerequisite edges mean the PDF does not provide prerequisite data; no prerequisite relationships or course order have been inferred.
schema_notes.scope: Includes all lower division core rows, both physics sequence options, and all 11 lower division elective entries. Repeated individual and bundled physics mappings refer to the same receiving courses. This is not the full 120-unit degree plan or a statement of pre-admission requirements.
schema_notes.policy_application: Apply the in-person lab policy to lab equivalence. CHEM 112L and ASTR 139 are explicitly listed as laboratory courses.
schema_notes.target_requirement: Version 1.1.0 adds target_requirement to every articulation record. It is a COURSE expression for a single receiving course or an AND expression for a receiving-course bundle. target_course_id is retained for single targets and is null for bundles; that null does not mean the target is unknown.
schema_notes.nested_groups: Evaluate AND or OR across the combined requirement_ids and group_ids. Empty lists provide no inputs. MINIMUM uses selection_constraints instead. agreement.root_requirement_group_id identifies the synthesized root.
schema_notes.minimum_operator: MINIMUM selects entries from requirement_ids while meeting both minimum_units and minimum_items. Count each fulfilled entry once and sum unique receiving-course units. It does not require all listed electives.
schema_notes.physics_repeated_rows: The PDF prints individual mappings and whole-sequence mappings for the same receiving physics courses. All rows are preserved. The synthesized OR between individual-mapping groups and whole-sequence rows represents alternative articulation coverage, not additional degree requirements. Receiving-course units must be deduplicated.
schema_notes.physics_option_a: Option A requires PHYS 125 AND PHYS 126. Both the individual mappings and the bundled mapping use Chabot PHYS 3A AND PHYS 3B.
schema_notes.physics_option_b: Option B requires PHYS 135 AND PHYS 136 AND PHYS 137. The PDF lists individual PHYS 7A, PHYS 7C, PHYS 7B mappings and a bundle mapped from either (PHYS 4A AND PHYS 4B AND PHYS 4C AND PHYS 5) OR (PHYS 7A AND PHYS 7C AND PHYS 7B). No individual equivalency from a PHYS 4-series course is inferred.
schema_notes.chemistry_bundles: The elective CHEM 111 maps alone to Chabot CHEM 1A in this agreement; no CHEM 111L is listed. CHEM 112 AND CHEM 112L maps to Chabot CHEM 1B.
schema_notes.astronomy_bundle: ASTR 138 AND ASTR 139 maps to Chabot ASTR 20 AND ASTR 30. Both source courses are required for this listed bundle.
